anvil.effect: Weapon upgrade offers can gain one additional stat bonus.

bloodycleaver.effect: Lifesteal activates Bloodmark stacks and hits gain a 50% Bloodmark chance.

dragonfire.effect: 15% on-hit chance to summon Dragonfire; Fire damage can Burn.

energycore.effect: Fires bursts of energy orbs at enemies; copies increase the output.

holybook.effect: +100 Max HP, +50 HP Regen; healing radiates damage nearby.
holybook.unlock: Beat the first Stage Boss without taking damage

joesdagger.effect: 1% Execute chance; each Execute grants permanent Damage.

lightningorb.effect: 25% on-hit chance to summon Lightning; Lightning can stun.

goldenring.effect: Its description says it does not seem to do anything.

snek.effect: Applies +4 Poison stacks and adds a 5% chance to burst stored Poison damage.

pot.effect: Raises weapon level caps by +10 initially, with diminishing returns to a +2 minimum.
pot.unlock: Clear every chest and pot in the first Crypt

soulharvester.effect: Every kill summons two homing souls.

speedboi.effect: Taking damage below 50% HP slows time and grants 2x Damage briefly.
speedboi.unlock: Clear a stage with at least 2 Boss Curses

suckymagnet.effect: Periodically pulls nearby XP shards toward the player.
suckymagnet.unlock: Complete every Charge Shrine on a map

zawarudo.effect: Fatal damage freezes time and consumes one copy.

overpoweredlamp.effect: Adds an independent extra roll to supported on-hit effects.

bigbonk.effect: 2% on-hit chance to BONK for 20x damage.

spicymeatball.effect: Attacks have a 25% chance to explode for 65% area damage.

icecube.effect: 20% on-hit chance to inflict Ice damage; Ice can freeze enemies.

giantfork.effect: +15% Crit Chance; Crits can become Megacrits with 4x base Megacrit damage and stack scaling.

powergloves.effect: 8% on-hit chance to create a damaging knockback blast.

chonkplate.effect: +20% Lifesteal and Overheal capacity equal to 75% of Max HP.

wizardshat.effect: Raises Tome level caps by +10 initially, with diminishing returns to a +2 minimum.
